title: Return policy
body: Unworn items with tags can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Final-sale items cannot be returned. Start a return at acme.example/returns with your order number and email.

title: Refund timing
body: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 3 business days after the warehouse receives your return. Your bank may take 5-10 additional business days to post it.

title: Exchanges
body: We don't do direct exchanges. Return the original item for a refund and place a new order for the size or color you want.

title: Shipping times and costs
body: Standard shipping is free on orders over $50 and takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping costs $15 and takes 1-2 business days. Orders placed before 2pm ET ship the same day.

title: International shipping
body: We ship to Canada, the UK and the EU. International orders take 7-14 business days. Duties and taxes are collected at checkout, so there are no surprise fees on delivery.

title: Lost or delayed packages
body: If tracking hasn't updated in 5 business days or shows delivered but you don't have it, contact us. We'll open a carrier claim and send a replacement or refund once the claim is filed.

title: Reset your password
body: Click 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page and enter your email. The reset link expires after 1 hour. Check spam if you don't see it within 5 minutes.

title: Change email or delete account
body: You can update your email under Account > Profile. To delete your account and personal data, submit a request at acme.example/privacy. Deletion completes within 30 days.

title: Price adjustments
body: If an item you bought goes on sale within 14 days of purchase, we'll refund the difference once. Contact support with your order number.
